name: WAeW World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: WAeW's own top singles championship, universal weight limit, defended only on pay-per-views absent the fed head's own say-so. The surviving record catches it mid-tournament: four qualifiers -- Lord Foul the Despiser, "Killer Kid" Brad Slack, Casey Stanfield and The Punisher -- were still cutting promos toward a first champion when the corpus ends, and no reign is attested anywhere in the held record.

name: WAeW North American Title
epitaph: WAeW's own secondary singles championship, a 290-pound weight limit, defended on pay-per-views and on live cards every four to six weeks per the fed's own FAQ. No reign, challenger or defense survives anywhere in the held record.

name: WAeW World Tag Team Title
epitaph: WAeW's own tag team championship, universal weight limit, defended only on pay-per-views absent the fed head's own say-so. The surviving record shows an opening tournament round building toward it (the Heartbreakers among the entrants) but no reign or result survives anywhere in the held record.
